answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock tokens in an on-chain vault before it can vote or earn. An attacker who tries to forge a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand deposits, so the cost grows in step with influence. Like cargo held at a wharf until customs clears it, the stake stays locked through an unbonding delay, and misbehavior proven by peers is slashed, making mass fake identities a losing bet.
